'''''Star Wars''''' is a ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series written by [[Charles Soule]] and published by [[Marvel Comics]], beginning in [[January]] of [[2020]]. It features the characters [[Luke Skywalker]], [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]], [[Chewbacca]], [[C-3PO]], and [[R2-D2]], and takes place between the events of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']]. It is a relaunch of [[Star Wars (2015)|the concluded comic series of the same name]] that ran from [[2015]] to [[2019]].<ref name="Announcement" /> On [[April 1]], [[2020]], Marvel Comics was forced to stall their publishing line due to the [[Wikipedia:Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] [[Wikipedia:2019–20 coronavirus pandemic|pandemic]].<ref name="Digital">{{WebCite|url=https://www.newsarama.com/49653-marvel-not-releasing-any-new-titles-this-week-print-or-digitally-but-may-change-in-future.html|text=MARVEL Not Releasing Any New Titles This Week Print or Digitally, But May Change in Future|date=2020-03-31|work=Newsarama.com|archivedate=20200331185910}}</ref> Eventually, Marvel announced they would resume their publishing line on [[May 27]], 2020,<ref name="Resume Publishing">{{WebCite|url=https://www.newsarama.com/50048-marvel-to-resume-new-comics-releases-may-27-announce-schedule-through-july-8.html|text=MARVEL To Resume New Comics Releases May 27, Announce Schedule Through July 8|date=2020-05-01|work=Newsarama.com|archivedate=20200519173904}}</ref> and the series resumed publication in [[August]] 2020 with issue [[Star Wars (2020) 5|5]].<ref name="August20Solicit">{{WebCite|url=https://www.newsarama.com/50291-marvel-comics-august-2020-solicitations.html|text=MARVEL COMICS AUGUST 2020 Solicitations|date=2020-05-21|work=Newsarama.com|archivedate=20200529200225}}</ref>

The series ends with [[Star Wars (2020) 50|issue 50]]. However, Soule considers the "[[Qi'ra]] trilogy"<ref name="Soule Newsletter">{{Twitter|SWSplashPagePod|status/1747693949962027452|''Star Wars'' Splash Page|quote=Again, subscribe to the newsletter. It's a great read.}}</ref> —the comic miniseries of ''[[Star Wars: War of the Bounty Hunters]]'', ''[[Star Wars: Crimson Reign]]'', and ''[[Star Wars: Hidden Empire]]''<ref name="WOTBH 5">[[War of the Bounty Hunters 5|''War of the Bounty Hunters'' 5]]</ref>—and the<ref name="Soule Newsletter" /> subsequent ''[[Star Wars: Dark Droids]]'' miniseries<ref name="Dark Droids">{{SW|url=news/swce-2023-marvel|text=SWCE 2023: Marvel Reveals ''Star Wars: Dark Droids'' Horror Event and More}}</ref> to be part of his ''Star Wars'' series,<ref name="Soule Newsletter" /> describing them as "tie-in series." As such, Soule considers ''Star Wars'' 2020 to be a seventy issue run and is very proud to have written such a long-lasting series in his favorite fictional playground.<ref name="Soule Proud">{{Twitter|CharlesSoule|status/1826262264262897993|[[Charles Soule]]|quote=Proud! Incredibly difficult to get a fifty-issue run, which was really a 70-issue run with the tie-in series, and in my favorite fictional world no less? How wonderful.}} {{C|In response to: "How do you feel looking back on your Star Wars run now that it's nearing its conclusion in #50?"}}</ref>
